title: True Ending
problem: exception list longer than its text
notes: | 2026-10-26 realign (text is the contract): text claims "Effects that activate when creatures die are ignored. This perk does not affect Born Again". Fix: H: True Ending: only Born Again may still run; the code lets everything above bc_OnDeath L163 run (see EFFECT_ORDER_FINDINGS on-death item 4). vs bugged: stronger. 2026-10-26 hook batch B2: left needs-hook. True Ending must skip every on-death effect except Born Again; the code lets everything above bc_OnDeath L163 run. A fix means moving the perk's early exit above those blocks (reordering bc_OnDeath), which a call-site hook can't do; needs a function-entry design. Round-3 F2 2026-10-26: built. Hook at bc_OnDeath L14 decides 'True Ending applies' exactly as L80 + L162 (scr_PerkLevel(448) > 0 and not scr_BattleType(arg) == 1); frameless detours jump L16 -> L80 (the game still sets its boss flag), L84 -> L90 (Born Again runs), L95 -> L162 (the game's own True Ending exit). In-game test: with True Ending, kill creatures that have on-death effects in the early blocks (Don't Touch My Garbage, Master of Robodomis, Epigraphy flag, Ultimate Ember / Somnus resurrection, Breath of Death, Angry Army, Croak of the King, Traumatism, Hate And Other Triumphs): none of them fire; Born Again still resurrects. In a boss battle (battle type 1) everything works as before.

release_notes.intended: Effects that activate when creatures die are ignored, except Born Again (not in boss battles).
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, a number of on-death effects still ran.
release_notes.fix: Now every on-death effect except Born Again is ignored; boss battles are unchanged.
